title: In Front, Underneath, and On Its Own
label: ch:bn-signs-around-the-letter
canDo: I can read নাম and তুমি, write the i-sign, the u-sign and the independent ই, and say what decides whether a vowel is written as a mark on a consonant or as a letter of its own.

payoff.summary: The familiar you read off the page as four pieces on three levels — head-line, a sign slung underneath, a sign standing in front — which is the chapter's whole claim about how Bengali is scanned.
